title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1982-09-18
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi DR-8 (w/no Dolby) > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab > R8Brain > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644
source: 2x Nakamichi CM300's with CP4 shotguns (L R), plus 1x Nakamichi CM300 with CP1 cardioid (blend mic) > Nakamichi 550 > Maxell XLII-S 90's. Mics on stand, set up in center right section riser, just off the floor.

ai_review.summary: Superb audience recording captures a high‑energy 1982 Garden show with standout Jack Straw > Sugaree opener, scorching West L.A., and a mellow Baby Blue encore.
ai_review.review: The tape delivers an unexpectedly clear AUD from the notoriously rough Garden venue, letting the band’s fire shine through from start to finish. Highlights include a ripping Jack Straw → Sugaree opening, the “hottest” performance of West L.A., a tight U‑B‑J sequence and a mellow Baby Blue encore, while Jerry’s vocals and guitar work are praised as top‑notch.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave high marks (4–5 stars) and emphasized both the show’s high energy and the surprisingly excellent audience recording, leading to a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note the AUD is surprisingly clear for the Garden, with good balance and no major drop‑outs; they even claim it outshines the soundboard version in soul.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong first set opener, a monster second set with tight transitions and a mellow encore; overall flow praised as solid and energetic.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Voice sounds particularly good and his playing is fantastic.
band_member_comments.Bob: Dedicated "Samson" to the building during the show.
